;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[June 2019 Syria attacks]]
***[[June 2019 Syria attacks|A car bomb]] in [[Azaz]] kills at least 21 people and leaves many wounded. [https://www.dw.com/en/syrian-town-of-azaz-hit-by-deadly-car-bombing/a-49010664 (DW)]
***A suicide car bomber kills five soldiers of the [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] and five civilians at a checkpoint in central [[Raqqa]], [[Syria]]. This and a nearby roadside bomb wound 20 people. [https://www.dw.com/en/syrias-raqqa-rocked-by-explosions-ngo/a-49003959 (DW)]
**[[Israel]] kills ten people in airstrikes conducted against [[Syrian military]] targets in the [[Golan Heights]] in response to two rockets fired at [[Mount Hermon]] late Saturday. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jun/02/ten-killed-in-israeli-airstrikes-in-syria-in-reply-to-rocket-attack (''The Guardian'')]

*Two car bombs targeting a unit of the [[Libyan National Army]] injure 18 people in the city center of [[Derna, Libya|Derna]], [[Libya]]. [https://mobile.reuters.com/article/amp/af/idAFKCN1T3088-OZATP (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Six people are killed after a landslide hit a three-story building in [[Yangchun]], [[China]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-06/02/c_138111336.htm (Xinhua)]
*An [[Enhanced Fujita scale|EF1]] [[tornado]] strikes the [[Orleans, Ontario|Orleans]] residential community of [[Ottawa, Canada]], creating a track of damage but without serious injuries. [https://ottawacitizen.com/news/local-news/tornado-warning-issued-for-gatineau-region (''Ottawa Citizen'')]

;International relations
*[[Canada–Venezuela relations]]
**[[Canada]] temporarily closes its embassy in [[Venezuela]] after Canadian diplomats were no longer able to get [[Letter of credence|diplomatic accreditation]] under [[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro|Nicolás Maduro's]] government according to a statement released by the [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Canada)|Canadian Minister of Foreign Affairs]], [[Chrystia Freeland]]. [https://www.canada.ca/en/global-affairs/news/2019/06/canada-suspends-operations-at-embassy-of-canada-to-venezuela.html {{nowrap|(Global Affairs Canada)}}] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/canada-venezuela-embassy-1.5159498 (CBC News)]

;Law and crime
*Jazz drummer [[Lawrence Leathers]] is found dead in his Bronx apartment building. Police arrested Lisa Harris and Sterling Aguilar. [https://www.npr.org/2019/06/03/729263193/lawrence-leathers-grammy-winning-jazz-drummer-victim-of-suspected-murder (NPR)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/03/nyregion/lawrence-leathers-dead.html (''The New York Times'')]
;Politics and elections
*[[Andrea Nahles]] announces her resignation as leader of [[Social Democratic Party of Germany|Germany's Social Democratic Party]], effective at the beginning of next week. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48490112 (BBC News)]
*[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] dismisses Minister of Justice [[Ayelet Shaked]] and Minister of Education [[Naftali Bennett]] from the interim government. [https://www.foxnews.com/world/israels-netanyahu-fires-hawkish-cabinet-minister-rivals (AP via Fox News)]
*King [[Juan Carlos I]] of Spain retires from public life five years after his abdication. [https://people.com/royals/spain-king-juan-carlos-retires-5-years-after-abdication/ (''People'')]
*During his visit to Romania, [[Pope Francis]] apologizes to the [[Romani people in Romania|Roma people]] on behalf of the Catholic Church and asks forgiveness for "all those times in history when we have discriminated, mistreated or looked askance at you." He also [[Beatification|beatifies]] seven [[Eastern Catholic Churches|Eastern Catholic church]] bishops who were jailed for treason and tortured [[Socialist Republic of Romania|under Communist rule]]. All died in confinement and were buried in secret. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-romania/pope-asks-forgiveness-for-historical-mistreatment-of-roma-people-idUSKCN1T30BP?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48490942 (BBC News)]
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces the resignation of [[Kevin Hassett]] as Chairman of the [[Council of Economic Advisers]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2019/06/03/kevin-hassett-president-trumps-top-economist-leave-white-house/?utm_term=.da94534215c9 (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2019 Sammarinese referendum]]
**Sanmmarinese voters vote to end discrimination based on sexual orientation and initiate a popular legislative initiative for the reform of the electoral system. [https://www.euronews.com/2019/06/04/san-marino-bans-discrimination-based-on-sexual-orientation (Euronews)]
;Science and technology
*[[Google]] has a [[Cloud computing|cloud]] services outage that affects [[Gmail]], [[Snapchat]], [[YouTube]] and other services in parts of the United States. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/06/02/google-says-its-looking-into-service-outages-as-cloud-experiences-larger-network-issue.html (CNBC)]
